analysis_kind: Offline analysis of existing user-operated original-client capture.
source_line_definition: 1-based lines in unmodified peak-bet-decoded.jsonl; directions emitted separately, not globally chronological.
selection: All 32 peakchampion 27700..27731 frames plus one 10302 asset projection; unrelated login and other champion systems excluded.
sanitization: Transport stream and raw payload omitted. Player identity and appearance fields recursively removed; tree ext omitted. Exact removed msg paths recorded per row. Gameplay values, A/B sides, tree positions, hero instance IDs retained. Asset projection is allowlisted.
limits: No UI screenshots or current button text collected.
27707 refreshes pool/odds; it is not 27705 bet history.
27716 is an empty notification and does not establish settlement.
One successful bet cannot establish odds formula, failed-bet behavior, or payout rounding.
Only one 10302 snapshot; activity can_bet is used for the stake delta.
No current-bet settlement, payout, like, own participation, or battle phase observed.
